evals.name: copilot-absence-detected-before-waiting
evals.prompt: Odpal pętlę review na PR 1 dla zmiany add-auth. To repozytorium nigdy nie miało recenzji od Copilota.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight finds no prior Copilot review across recent pull requests and warns before starting, naming how long a fruitless run would take. It asks whether to continue rather than aborting on its own — absence of history is not proof Copilot is disabled.

evals.name: first-ever-pr-reported-as-inconclusive
evals.prompt: Uruchom cykl review na PR 1, zmiana add-auth. To pierwszy PR w tym repozytorium.
evals.expected_output: The availability check reports itself inconclusive rather than negative, in one line, and proceeds. A repository with no prior pull requests has no history to read, and treating that as a negative result would block a legitimate first run.

evals.name: timeout-names-both-possibilities
evals.prompt: [po wyczerpaniu poll_timeout bez nowej recenzji] Podsumuj przebieg.
evals.expected_output: The termination report distinguishes the two states a timeout cannot tell apart: Copilot being slow versus Copilot not reviewing this repository at all. It tells the user how to settle it — check whether the reviewers sidebar offers a Copilot entry — instead of asserting that a re-run will work.

evals.name: missing-change-directory-prompts
evals.prompt: Odpal review-loop na PR 6 dla zmiany restructure-reply-skeleton.
evals.expected_output: Pre-flight cannot find openspec/changes/restructure-reply-skeleton/, lists nearby candidates including the archived directory, and pauses for the user to choose. It does not guess the closest-looking name and carry on.

evals.name: clean-termination-when-nothing-new
evals.prompt: PR 12, zmiana add-agent-working-mode — poprowadź cykl aż się ustabilizuje.
evals.expected_output: When Copilot returns no new comments, the loop stops with reason no-comments and reports totals across iterations. It does not keep cycling to the iteration cap, and it does not report success in a way that conflates 'nothing new' with 'everything was fixed'.

evals.name: sign-off-issue-matched-by-exact-title
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła się na PR 12 z powodem no-comments. W repozytorium wisi otwarte zgłoszenie zatytułowane "Flaky test on PR #12 breaks review-loop". Dokończ krok 6.
evals.expected_output: The existing issue is not treated as the sign-off record — its title is not the canonical one, and a loose search that matched it would leave the gate uncreated. A new issue is opened with the exact canonical title, its body is written to a file outside the repository rather than passed as a shell argument, and it ends with the verbatim closing line naming that only a person may close it.

evals.name: ungated-run-is-announced-not-swallowed
evals.prompt: Pętla skończyła na PR 5, ale zgłoszenia są w tym repozytorium wyłączone i polecenie zakładające je zwraca błąd.
evals.expected_output: The failure is retried once, and when it still fails the run is declared ungated in a line the report cannot bury — naming that nothing records the need for human eyes and that an issue has to be opened by hand before merging. The loop does not report completion as though the gate existed, and does not quietly move on.
